faqs.q: Where is the Sunset map set in Valorant?
faqs.a: Sunset is set in Los Angeles and is a two-site map, with bomb sites A and B connected by a busy Mid area. Its tight site entrances and flank routes through Mid reward teams that control the centre of the map and watch their flanks.

faqs.q: Why is Mid control so important on Sunset?
faqs.a: Mid connects both sites, so the team that holds it can rotate faster, cut off enemy rotations and threaten either A or B. On attack, taking Mid lets you split onto a site; on defence, losing it opens up your flanks, which is why smokes, traps and sensors are often used there.

faqs.q: Which agents are easiest for beginners on Sunset?
faqs.a: Brimstone, Cypher and Killjoy are good choices for newer players, because their smokes and traps are simple to place and give steady value every round. Gekko is also forgiving, since Wingman can plant or defuse the Spike and some of his creatures can be picked up and reused.

faqs.q: Is Sunset always in the Valorant competitive map pool?
faqs.a: No. Riot rotates maps in and out of the competitive pool from time to time, so Sunset may not be available in every act. Check the current map pool in the game or in the latest patch notes before you spend time practising Sunset-specific strategies.
